title: How Al Tamimi & Company is joining the UAE's push to lead on AI with Legora
summary: Legora is the collaborative AI powering lawyers to review and research faster, draft smarter, and advise with precision. Legora adapts to your ways of working, unlocking team and machine collaboration at scale.
body_markdown:
Al Tamimi & Company has made Legora part of its working practice, from legal research and drafting to translation between English and Arabic. Chairman and Founder Essam Al Tamimi says the partnership reflects the UAE’s ambition to become a leader in AI, and its investment to get there. He says the firm wants to be part of that drive, and that Legora will fill “a very important part” of it.“It’s not translation, it’s not a search engine,” he says. “It goes beyond that.”


That matters most in legal Arabic; Vincent Percival, Senior Knowledge Translation, explains that the work is not just about converting terms from one language to another. “You’re translating one legal system to another legal system,” he says.


Getting that right is the test, and the team has seen Legora pass it. Mariam Sabet, Partner, Corporate Commercial, found that when she checked an Arabic text against Legora’s own translation, “it got it right.”


Speed is the other benefit. Mohammad Al Muhtaseb, Partner, Dispute Resolution, describes a recent matter in which the team had to file around 500 pages across several reports and memoranda within three days. Legora gave the team the comfort that they would meet the deadline, and the result surprised even them. “We were amazed that we were able to do it,” he says.


Malak Nasredinne, Senior Associate, explains how lawyers who once expected to spend a whole night on a task can now run it through Legora for a first draft. Essam sees the same shift in research. He says lawyers can now leave his office at midday and be back by two or three with a summary of the research.


Mariam adds that some of the associates she works with have become “much more analytical” and are looking at issues in greater depth, because Legora “actually really challenges you.”


For Al Tamimi, Legora is part of how the firm intends to lead in a region that is investing seriously in AI. “We believe in Legora’s system,” Essam says, and he looks forward to a continued relationship.
